note: Orange Gate DBR Rev 0 hydraulic arrangement: pumped high-pressure looped ring main. DN150 looped SS316L main, DN65 zone header, DN40 row distribution, loop factor 0.25 (Darcy–Weisbach worst-path, ring-main split flow). Pump: 2 × 72 m³/h duty + 1 standby (total 144 m³/h). Efficiencies: pump 0.68, motor 0.93. Design margin 10 % on flow, 10 % on pressure (rated_bar = 1.10 × required). Tank: 143.6 m³ for 60 min at design flow. Power target 375 kW motor input (650 kW gate = 2 × 325 kW feeders). Spec ref: DBR §4.5 (ring main), §5.7 (hydraulics calculations).
